scope: TensorRT RAFT-large app gate on Jetson Orin ARM64 (TRT 10.16.2); promotes the TRT cell of `Optical flow (raft)` from B to P. P covers this model + environment only.

build.flags: -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DDEFAULT_BACKEND=TENSORRT (existing build-nano-trt dir; not a fresh configure)
build.export: torchvision raft_large DEFAULT weights via neuriplo-tasks TritonRAFTWrapper (input1/input2 in, flow_prediction out, opset 16). Two deviations from sibling script, both forced by toolchain: (1) dynamo=False — torch 2.15 defaults torch.onnx.export to the dynamo exporter whose decomposition pass fails on RAFT corr_block; (2) static 1x3x520x960 export — dynamic-axes ONNX fails TRT 10.16 engine build ('Could not find any implementation for node ForeignNode[...Cast/Reshape...]'). See /tmp/raft_export_legacy.py logic.

gate.checked: render inspected: coherent Middlebury-color flow on the frame pair — moving figure (magenta) and ball (green) distinct from background wash; static-shape engine matches the app's 520x960 input sizes
